## Source: amazon-inspector (d69c1a6ef8056459c53ad1730c111c11a4e22384300f450f07eeb405af562324)
setup.py defines a pingback() routine that executes unconditionally at module top level during sdist build. On `pip install`, it collects the installer's username (whoami/id), hostname, current working directory, the contents of /etc/hosts, and a timestamp, then POSTs them as JSON to https://pingback.zsdsh.xyz/depconf/gateio-ws/. The destination host is unrelated to the gate.io ecosystem and the URL path segment `depconf` together with the implausibly high 99.99.1 version number are consistent with a dependency-confusion squat targeting an internal package name. No wheels are published, so a default `pip install gateio-ws` on every supported platform builds the sdist and triggers the beacon.
